main.description: Returns the representative raw follow record, or null, for each requested actor-to-actor relationship. Authentication is not required. Supply 1–100 repeated subjects values; the encoded GET request-target must not exceed 7,000 bytes.

actor.description: DID of the actor who published the follow records.

subjects.description: Subject DIDs to check, supplied as repeated unbracketed query values. Every occurrence is returned in the same order, including duplicates.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor DID, subjects array, request-target length, or another query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: ActorFollowQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed follow relationships could not be queried.

results.description: One result per supplied subject occurrence, in request order.

subject.description: Subject DID from the corresponding request occurrence.

follow.description: Earliest indexed matching record by createdAt, with URI ascending on ties, or null when no relationship is indexed. Query failures are errors, not null results.
